web:95028705b6a4.title: Education Statistics Digest 2025, Section 1 Table 4
web:95028705b6a4.finding: There were 237,966 primary students in 2024; this is the context population, not the number of buyers.
web:95028705b6a4.limitation: Counts students, not paying buyers. Table 2 and Table 4 disagree (230,968 vs 237,966). Says nothing about tuition centres.

web:1bfdc89eda0d.title: Singapore families spent S$1.8 billion on private tuition in 2023
web:1bfdc89eda0d.publisher: Malay Mail (citing Straits Times / SingStat household expenditure survey)
web:1bfdc89eda0d.quote: Families in Singapore reportedly spent S$1.8 billion (RM6 billion) on private tuition for their children in 2023
web:1bfdc89eda0d.finding: Households spend heavily on private tuition, so centres have paying customers; it does not show centres would buy diagnostic software.
web:1bfdc89eda0d.limitation: Secondary report; primary SingStat table not opened. All subjects and levels, not primary maths. Household spending on tuition, not centre spending on software.

web:80228e3fc017.title: Singapore's education ministry to deploy more AI in schools after success of Primary 5 maths tool
web:80228e3fc017.quote: uses machine learning to make customised learning recommendations for each student
web:80228e3fc017.finding: MOE already gives schools an ML-based adaptive maths system, a free alternative in schools.
web:80228e3fc017.limitation: 2023 article; current coverage (levels, topics) not checked on an MOE page. Price to schools not stated. A state-provided alternative in schools, not in tuition centres.

web:72fb9750332e.title: Singapore's Education Ministry to deploy more AI in schools after success of primary 5 maths tool
web:72fb9750332e.quote: launched the Adaptive Learning System for mathematics, for three topics covered at the Primary 5 level.
web:72fb9750332e.finding: The text mentions the deployment of an Adaptive Learning System for primary mathematics by the education ministry.
web:72fb9750332e.limitation: The quote does not address whether the tool provides tutor-reviewed, evidence-traceable learning-gap reports sold to tuition centres.

web:4ee018643b7f.title: Online Education in Singapore: How Geniebook Supports Academic Success
web:4ee018643b7f.quote: AI-driven platforms like Geniebook tailor lessons based on students’ strengths and weaknesses, ensuring targeted improvement and better subject mastery.
web:4ee018643b7f.finding: The text shows that Geniebook provides AI-driven personalized lessons targeting student strengths and weaknesses.
web:4ee018643b7f.limitation: The quote does not explicitly state whether these reports are tutor-reviewed, evidence-traceable, or sold specifically to tuition centres.
